annotations.text:
Three variations on the map-forward direction you picked.

Same anatomy every time — a real district map, the site name, one address field — with the type, the palette and the shape of the search changed between them. The primary action is "Find My Maps" in all three; candidates and election dates are demoted to a secondary line, so the maps read as the product and the rest as what comes with them.

Each board has a light/dark toggle and an accent swatch in the tweaks row above it.

Two things to decide alongside the direction:

Fonts — Fraunces + Inter (1), Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono (2), DM Serif Display + Manrope (3). All webfonts, so one Google Fonts <link> in index.html. Say the word and I'll refit whichever you pick to system fonts.

Chakra UI — nothing here needs it; all three are plain CSS. If it goes in, the field, button and tag map onto Chakra primitives and these palettes become a theme token set. The SVG map stays hand-drawn either way.

The district chip on Meridian is sample text, not a real lookup.
